projects.name: Steward Crew
projects.description: AI agents that triage open-source contributors, with a human in the loop. Built for the Flip the Switch hackathon; write-up on dev.to and a 3-minute demo on YouTube.
highlights: Built 3 AI agents across Discord and Slack for the Flip the Switch hackathon (WeMakeDevs): one answers newcomers from the real codebase, one writes maintainers a daily triage of claims and PRs, and one drafts PR reviews.

Designed the safety model so no AI can act on GitHub: agents only file proposals, and a plain-Python "Ledger" service holding the only GitHub token acts only after a maintainer types approve, with a full audit log and undo.

Encoded project rules (one open claim per newcomer, claims stale after 48 hours, PR spam checks) as deterministic Python driven by a YAML policy, over a shared SQLite store; ~2,800-line package with 32 pytest tests.

projects.name: BizFlow
projects.description: GST invoicing and cash-flow platform for small businesses.
highlights: Developed a monorepo with a Next.js / React dashboard and an Express REST API on PostgreSQL (pooled connections, indexed foreign keys) for invoices, payments and business records.
Wrote a shared GST engine package that computes CGST + SGST for intra-state and IGST for inter-state invoices, and generates UPI QR codes for payment.
Secured the API with JWT authentication and role-based access control, and verified Razorpay payment webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

projects.name: URL Shortener REST API
projects.description: Production-style REST API for short links.
highlights: Implemented a REST API for short links with JWT auth, custom slugs, expiry and click analytics; visitor IPs are stored only as salted SHA-256 hashes.
Validated every request with Zod schemas that also generate the OpenAPI 3.1 docs; added rate limiting, security headers, structured logging and health checks.
Wrote 46 unit and integration tests (~95% coverage), each on a fresh in-memory database, run in GitHub Actions CI; packaged as a Docker image.

projects.name: DJ Cartel
highlights: Developed a React storefront with product catalog, cart and wishlist (Context + reducer state) and Google sign-in, backed by an Express REST API with Prisma and JWT-protected cart routes.
